missing.recapture: Feasible as guest. Every plaza shot with other avatars is rejected, so reshoot the phone plaza clip (780x1688, 5s, HUD hidden): walk toward camera with the pet following, stop, then do the cheer emote (open smile, no wink). At least two other avatars within about 5 m with placeholder tags (Luna, Kiko, Bao...) must be visible. First fix the name swap so it also covers auto-generated guest names of the form 'Adjective Animal NN' (Sunny Otter 12, Mint Gecko 42, Brave Panda 31 all got through), and check every frame edge. Also fix the screen-door dither haze that covers the frame once the camera stops (seen in plaza.mp4 after 2.2s, plaza-wave.mp4, plaza-2/3.png). Reshoot plaza-desktop.mp4 the same way; its composition was the best in the folder.

Feasible as guest. Reshoot emote-cheer (it has the best face: open smile, arms up) as a 3s front close-up framed from just under the YOU tag to the feet, with nobody else in frame: turn the camera so the background is the swings/planter with no walkway, or wait until other players leave, and confirm no second tag at any edge. Reshoot jump so the jump is actually in frame (start recording after the camera settles, trigger the emote at 0.5s). Reshoot wave and think with the avatar facing the camera; both current takes show only her back.

Partly feasible. Feasible: retake look-pirate-pose.png with no other player or tag in frame, and retake look-warrior-pose.png on a frame where the eyes are open (current frame has a dark eye hole). Prefer a pose without the wink for all five, since the wink renders as a coloured patch on punch-in. Not feasible as guest: a real five-avatar group shot (one account, one avatar) and a vector logo; the editor composites the five look-* stills and uses logo.png at no more than its native 1089 px.

Mostly not feasible as guest. A populated rankings board cannot be filmed (guests are unranked; rankings.png is empty and rejected), so the editor's drawn board stands. Feasible bonus: a 2s phone clip of the top-left HUD chip (it reads 'Level 5 - 400 XP' in plaza-desktop-ui.png) as XP ticks up after a round, framed tight on the chip with no other player tags behind it.

Feasible as guest, optional. All eight games are covered. Star Swarm is the weakest: reshoot 4s at wave 3 or later with more enemies and shots on screen and a +20 pop every second. Fishing: start the take 1s before the catch so the fish pop lands mid-clip rather than in the last second.

summary: Round 2 delivers PLAY and CREATE: all eight mini-games are real rounds with moving scores, and the five free class sets swap cleanly in the wardrobe. HANG OUT is still missing, because every plaza shot with other avatars shows a non-placeholder name tag (Sunny Otter 12, Mint Gecko 42, Brave Panda 31) and the phone plaza takes also carry a dither haze; the name swap is not catching auto-generated guest names. HOOK is thin: of six emote clips only victory and dance are usable, two are rejected for a 'Sunny' tag and two show the avatar from behind. Eleven files are rejected, ten for readable names and one for an empty rankings view. Avatar close-ups have model flaws the editor must frame around: the wink renders as a coloured patch and the hat floats above a bare scalp.
